What room is this? It's kinda bleak.\nAlso although the ceiling is high, it seems\nsmall...
Oh gosh!! W-what's this?!
I-I see~.\nSo this illusionary wall is to confuse people.\nI wonder why they created this kind of trick...
Hmph, I dunno why you came here, but\nI won't let you get in my way!
What's that cat?\nCould it be its doing?
Anyhow, if it's setting this kind of trick, that\nmeans it won't let us get to top floor peacefully.\nLet's find it immediately!
Alright! Now we can go to the next floor!
Hmph, you might have figured this simple trick\nout easily, but the next one won't be that easy!
Hey, waiiit!
Hey, don't just stand there!\nLet's get going!
Hm? This room is so weird. It's spacious but the\nceiling seems low.
Oh gosh!! I-it vanished?! Could it be...
Geez! That means a vertical illusion has been\nadded too this time. Okay, fine!\nChallenge accepted!!
Alright! We found another stairs!
Ha! You're doing better than I thought!\nBut you'll fail the next one for sure!
Stop it!! We've had enough with you, kitty!\nAre you holding a grudge against Xmas?
Don't call me kitty! I do have a name!\nIt's Yule Cat!
Moreover, I'm not holding any grudges.\nBut I'm not the only one that is worried about\nthis situation.
Look! My friends and my fellow felines agreed to\nthis too!
Er...\nAre you sure that thing is also a cat?
Hm?
I'm not sure how I can answer your question...\nB-but, all I wanna do is get back my peaceful\ndays!
...?\nWhat does that mean?
Oh well, who cares!\nLet's just focus on our goal!\nWe're here for the reward, so let's get going!
Hm? I wonder what kind of trick is set up here.
Oh! It's the stupid cat again!\nWhat trick are you trying to pull this time?!
It seems that what I've done so far has failed to\nbear fruit. I'll play my trump card then!
W-what? So you mean another one is coming?
They're my trump card!\nCome if you wanna play with them!
Er...are we gonna play with that thing too?
Hm?
T-they're my trump card!\nCome if you wanna play with them!
Oh, c'mon! This is taking up way too much time...\nWe should ask for extra rewards!
Alright! Found another stairs!
Grrr...I didn't expect you to come this far!\nBut as long as I don't let you get to the top\nfloor, it's fine!
Why do you wanna stop Xmas from being celebrated\nso badly?
I just wanna spend Xmas quietly!
What does that mean?\nIs that thing saying that it is not planning to\ninterrupt Xmas celebrations?
Maybe it's better if we tell Velly and Dunder\nabout this. For now, let's go back to where Dunder\nis!
